description.content: Adds new service overbooking limits with the specified conditions. Past overbooking limits cannot be updated outside of `OperationalEditableHistoryInterval`. Care is needed to specify `FirstTimeUnitStartUtc` and `LastTimeUnitStartUtc` in the correct format - see [Datetimes](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/serialization#datetimes). description.content: Deletes service overbooking limits that exactly match the specified conditions. This operation is intended to be used alongside `serviceOverbookingLimits/set`. The specified conditions must be met exactly. The time interval, however, does not need to correspond to an existing service overbooking limit in the system, instead the API uses a splicing algorithm to work out how to divide up any existing service overbooking limit to meet the specified time interval. Past overbooking limits cannot be cleared outside of `OperationalEditableHistoryInterval`. Care is needed to specify `FirstTimeUnitStartUtc` and `LastTimeUnitStartUtc` in the correct format - see [Datetimes](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/serialization#datetimes). This operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
